definition: In natural language processing, textual entailment (TE), also known as natural language inference (NLI), is a directional relation between text fragments.
details: The relation holds whenever the truth of one text fragment follows from another text.
story: Picture a translator at the United Nations, listening to one language and whispering the meaning into another in real time. In plain words: In natural language processing, textual entailment (TE), also known as natural language inference (NLI), is a directional relation between text fragments. Here is how it actually plays out: The relation holds whenever the truth of one text fragment follows from another text. Meaning lives in company — a word is known by the words it keeps. That pattern-earned fluency is Textual entailment.
